meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Cleans up cookie banners and ads; hides the donate pop-up, mascot, visualizer; blur or hide album art and background art
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome over CDP: iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA on listen.moe (home page only; the site is a single-page app and every other view needs the player). LISTEN.moe serves the same responsive Tailwind app to both user agents, so the same selectors apply to both. Classes are Tailwind utility names (stable, readable) but carry no meaning, so selectors prefer hrefs, aria labels, `data-lyrics-trigger` and image paths. `aria-label` and `alt` values are English-only.

- **Donate pop-up** (LIVE, 1): the fixed bottom-right animated `donate.gif` link, found by its `src`.
- **Album art** choice (LIVE, 3 images on desktop: the large card and two players): `a[href^="/albums/"] img`; blur or hide. The song title stays.
- **Background art** choice (LIVE, 2 images): the full-screen J-POP and K-POP photos behind the app; blur or hide.
- **Mascot** (LIVE, 1): the girl sprite above the player, found by `/images/girls/`.
- **Visualizer** (LIVE, 3 canvases): the animated waveform behind the player cards.
- **Lyrics button** (LIVE, 2) and **Listener count** (LIVE, 1 "N listening" in the desktop sidebar).
- The three original cookie, ad and app-banner rules are kept unchanged; the site showed none of them logged out (generic rules, harmless if nothing matches).

The album art and listener counter were seen in a first same-day capture while a song played; the metadata feed did not load in later runs, so `real-playing.html` and `desktop-real-playing.html` are trimmed by hand from that capture. Not verified: the logged-in views (favorites, playlists), the search overlay and the lyrics dialog, which need an account or playback.
